props.name: data
props.description: The tree: structures with ids, labels and children.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected structure id, or null.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the id a reader selects.

props.name: visibility
props.description: Missing IDs are visible. Branches summarize their leaf descendants.

props.name: onVisibilityChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility after a show or hide.

props.name: defaultExpandedIds
props.description: Branches open on first render.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the tree.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected region ids.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new selection.

props.name: regions
props.description: Defaults to bodyMapRegions. Replace labels or shapes to customize.

props.name: views
props.description: Which figures to show, front and back by default.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits one hidden input per selected region inside a form.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the map.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected dermatome, such as L4, or null.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the dermatome a reader selects, or null.

props.name: views
props.description: Defaults to both views, front first.

props.name: colors
props.description: CSS colors by level, for example to show sensory test results.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Defaults to true. Labels show once a figure is at least 16rem wide.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the map.

props.name: disease
props.description: The disease: its scales, stages, findings and investigations.

props.name: scale
props.description: The scale shown, by ID.

props.name: defaultScale
props.description: The scale shown first when `scale` is not set. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onScaleChange
props.description: Called with the scale a reader chooses.

props.name: stage
props.description: The stage shown, by ID.

props.name: defaultStage
props.description: The stage shown first when `stage` is not set. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onStageChange
props.description: Called with the stage a reader chooses.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected structure ID, or null.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the structure a reader selects, or null when they clear it.

props.name: panel
props.description: Shows the panel with the stages, scales, findings and investigations. Defaults to true.

props.name: sequence
props.description: One strand, read 5′ to 3′. Whitespace is ignored; only A, C, G and T are allowed.

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Base pair index, from 0 at the 5′ end.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the selected pair's index and its bases.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Spins the helix slowly about its axis until the user pauses it or moves the camera. Off when the user prefers reduced motion. Defaults to true.

props.name: strands
props.description: Shows the selectable sequence of both strands below the stage. Defaults to true.

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the rotation, zoom and reset buttons. Defaults to true.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the viewer.

props.name: ref
props.description: Rotates, zooms and resets the camera from your own controls.

props.name: samples
props.description: A recorded trace in millivolts. Ignored when `stream` is set.

props.name: stream
props.description: A live source, drawn as a monitor sweep.

props.name: sampleRate
props.description: Samples per second. Defaults to 250.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds shown across the strip. Defaults to the whole recording, or 6 seconds for a stream.

props.name: speed
props.description: Paper speed in mm/s. Defaults to the standard 25.

props.name: gain
props.description: Gain in mm/mV. Defaults to the standard 10.

props.name: range
props.description: Lowest and highest millivolts shown. Defaults to -1.5 to 2.

props.name: lead
props.description: The lead name shown in the caption. Defaults to II.

props.name: annotations
props.description: Wave labels. Detected from the signal unless given; pass false to hide them. Streams are always detected.

props.name: calibration
props.description: Draws the 1 mV calibration pulse before the trace. Defaults to true.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the strip. Defaults to "ECG".

props.name: standards
props.description: The LMS reference tables you supply, such as WHO's.

props.name: measure
props.description: weight, length (length or height) or head circumference.

props.name: sex
props.description: female or male; the standards differ by sex.

props.name: measurements
props.description: The child's measurements, by age in months.

props.name: percentiles
props.description: Percentile curves to draw, between 0 and 100. Defaults to WHO's set.

props.name: ageRange
props.description: Age range shown, in months. Defaults to 0 to 24.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the chart.

props.name: slices
props.description: The image slices, each with its width, height and pixel values.

props.name: slice
props.description: Zero-based index of the shown slice, when controlled.

props.name: defaultSlice
props.description: The slice shown first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSliceChange
props.description: Called with the new slice index.

props.name: window
props.description: The window centre and width, when controlled.

props.name: defaultWindow
props.description: Defaults to the first preset, or else the first slice's value range.

props.name: onWindowChange
props.description: Called with the new window after a drag or preset.

props.name: presets
props.description: Named windows offered in the toolbar, such as `ctWindowPresets`.

props.name: pixelSpacing
props.description: Physical [row, column] spacing, as in DICOM Pixel Spacing, so pixels keep their true aspect.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown after pixel values, such as "HU".

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the toolbar and slice slider. Defaults to true.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the image.

props.name: ref
props.description: Moves through slices, zooms and resets the view from your own controls.

props.name: results
props.description: The results, each with its value, unit, range and history.

props.name: caption
props.description: Names the table for assistive technology and shows below it.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Defaults to a UTC date such as "Oct 1, 2026".

props.name: showTrend
props.description: Shows the trend column. Defaults to true.

props.name: medications
props.description: The medications, each with its dose times and days.

props.name: interactions
props.description: Interactions come from your own data source; none are bundled.

props.name: date
props.description: The day shown, "YYYY-MM-DD".

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Shows previous and next day buttons when set.

props.name: doseStatus
props.description: Missing doses are still to take.

props.name: onDoseStatusChange
props.description: Makes each dose's status a button that cycles to take, taken, skipped.

props.name: now
props.description: The current local time, "HH:MM", drawn as a marker on the timeline.

props.name: locale
props.description: Used to format the date heading. Defaults to "en-US".

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the schedule.

props.name: disclaimer
props.default: "Interaction warnings come only from the data this schedule is given. This is not medical advice."
props.description: Shown under the schedule. Pass null to hide it.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of a PDB or mmCIF file. Ignored when `data` is given.

props.name: data
props.description: PDB or mmCIF text.

props.name: format
props.description: Detected from the text when omitted.

props.name: representation
props.description: Cartoon, sticks, spheres and so on, when controlled.

props.name: defaultRepresentation
props.description: The representation shown first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onRepresentationChange
props.description: Called when a reader picks another representation.

props.name: colorScheme
props.description: How atoms and residues are coloured, when controlled.

props.name: defaultColorScheme
props.description: The colour scheme shown first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onColorSchemeChange
props.description: Called when a reader picks another colour scheme.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Residue ID, such as `A:16`.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.type: ( id: string | null, residue: MoleculeResidue | null ) => void
props.description: Called with the selected residue's id and details, or null.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called once a structure is parsed.

props.name: water
props.description: Shows water molecules. Defaults to false.

props.name: sequence
props.description: Shows the selectable sequence below the stage. Defaults to true.

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the style and colour menus, zoom and reset buttons. Defaults to true.

props.name: attribution
props.description: Links the entry on RCSB PDB when the file names its ID. Defaults to true.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the viewer.

props.name: ref
props.description: Zooms, rotates and resets the camera from your own controls.

props.name: model
props.description: The model: its GLB, structures, named views and credit.

props.name: src
props.description: Overrides `model.src`, for example to serve the GLB yourself.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected structure id, or null.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the structure a reader selects.

props.name: visibility
props.description: Missing IDs are visible, matching the anatomy tree's contract.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The named view shown first.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view name, or null once the camera is rotated freely.

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the view menu, zoom and reset buttons. Defaults to true.

props.name: attribution
props.description: Shows a button that opens the model credit and licence link. Keep it unless you credit the model elsewhere.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the viewer.

props.name: ref
props.description: Sets views, zooms, rotates and resets from your own controls.

props.name: readings
props.description: The latest value of each vital; null when not measured.

props.name: ranges
props.description: Merged over `adultVitalRanges`, one vital at a time.

props.name: vitals
props.description: Which vitals to show, in order.

props.name: temperatureUnit
props.description: The unit of `readings.temperature` and `ranges.temperature`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Used to format numbers.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the readings.

props.name: description
props.description: Shown under the title, such as when the readings were taken.
